children: National CineMedia closed new senior secured credit facilities totaling $300 million, led by Crestline Direct Finance, to fund its Captivate acquisition, refinance prior borrowings, and cover fees. The package includes a $275 million term loan and a $25 million revolver maturing Sep 18, 2031. Concurrently, the company repaid and terminated its 2025 U.S. Bank facility, releasing all associated liens and guarantees. Management expects the new financing to support integration and provide ongoing liquidity.
: Senior secured first lien term loan and revolving credit facility
: Crestline Direct Finance, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Finance Captivate acquisition and refinance existing debt

: Refreshed with new facilities tied to Captivate acquisition
